title: 「There is more to X than Y」句
titleZh: 「There is more to X than Y」表示事情不只表面因素
titleEn: There is more to X than Y

formula: There is more to X than Y

formulas.formula: There is more to X than Y
There was / has been / had been / will be more to X than Y
There may / could / must be more to X than Y
There seems / appears to be more to X than Y
Is / Was / Could there be more to X than Y?
Subject + verb + that + there is more to X than Y
There is more to it than that
There is more to X than + clause
There is more to X than meets the eye

meaning.zh: 表示 X 涉及的不只是 Y；X 比表面提到的 Y 更複雜、更廣泛，或包含更多因素。

rules.zh: to 是介詞，不是不定詞標記；後面通常接名詞、代名詞、動名詞或名詞短語。
rules.en: To is a preposition in this structure, not an infinitive marker. It is normally followed by a noun, pronoun, gerund or noun phrase.

rules.zh: Y 代表 X 的有限部分、可能原因、過分簡單的理解或最先被注意的表面因素。
rules.en: Y must represent a limited part, possible cause, oversimplified understanding or surface feature of X.

rules.zh: be 可按時態變為 is、was、has been、had been 或 will be。
rules.en: Change be for time: is, was, has been, had been or will be.

rules.zh: 情態動詞後使用 be：may be、could be 或 must be，不可說 may is。
rules.en: Use be after a modal verb: may be, could be or must be, not may is.

rules.zh: 配合 seem 或 appear 時，完整外殼是 There seems / appears to be more to X than Y。
rules.en: With seem or appear, retain the complete shell There seems / appears to be more to X than Y.

rules.zh: 疑問句把 be 放在 there 前；配合情態動詞可用 Could there be ...?。
rules.en: In questions, place be before there; a modal question may begin Could there be ...?

rules.zh: 目標結構可放在 realise、understand、explain 或 suggest 等動詞後，不一定在整句開首。
rules.en: The target may appear after verbs such as realise, understand, explain or suggest rather than at the start of the whole sentence.

rules.zh: 它也可嵌入 what 子句、the fact that 結構或 whether 子句，核心形式不變。
rules.en: It can also be embedded in a what-clause, a the fact that structure or a whether-clause without changing the core expression.

rules.zh: There is more to it than that 是常見說法；it 指正在討論的事情，that 指剛提出的解釋。
rules.en: There is more to it than that is a common expression. It refers to the matter under discussion and that refers to the explanation just given.

rules.zh: than meets the eye 是固定結尾，表示事情比表面所見更複雜或更有內涵。
rules.en: Than meets the eye is a fixed idiomatic ending meaning that something is more complex or substantial than it appears.

rules.zh: a lot、much 和 far 可放在 more 前加強程度，但不是核心必要部分。
rules.en: Degree expressions such as a lot, much and far may precede more to strengthen the comparison, but they are optional.

rules.zh: just 和 merely 可放在 Y 前加強「不只是」的意思，但沒有它們句子仍完整。
rules.en: Just and merely may strengthen the idea that Y is only one part, but they are optional.

rules.zh: 比較須使用 than，不要誤寫成表示「然後／當時」的 then。
rules.en: Use than for the comparison, not then, which refers to time or sequence.

rules.zh: 保持正確的 be 結構；不可說 There has more，現在完成式須用 There has been more。
rules.en: Keep the correct be structure. Do not write There has more; the present perfect is There has been more.

benefits.zh: 指出事情還有其他重要因素，並非只有表面所見或單一解釋。
benefits.en: It shows that a matter is not as simple as its surface appearance or one isolated explanation.

benefits.zh: 不用直接說對方完全錯誤，也能有禮貌地糾正過分簡單的看法。
benefits.en: It politely corrects an oversimplified view without directly declaring the other person wrong.

benefits.zh: 先指出還有其他因素，便可自然帶出下一步詳細解釋。
benefits.en: It naturally prepares the reader for a following explanation of additional factors.

benefits.zh: 避免把成功、教育、健康或領導等複雜題目縮成單一因素，令作文和討論更有深度。
benefits.en: It adds depth to essays and discussion by preventing complex subjects from being reduced to a single factor.

benefits.zh: 配合 may、could 或 seem，可表達表面原因可能不足以解釋整件事。
benefits.en: With may, could or seem, it expresses uncertainty or suspicion that a surface reason is incomplete.

benefits.zh: 提供 not only 以外的自然句式，增加表達變化。
benefits.en: It offers a natural alternative to repeated use of not only and increases sentence variety.
